name: postText
label: Post Text
help: Post content, must be up to 3000 characters

name: companyUrl
label: Company URL
help: LinkedIn company page URL. If specified, the post will be created on the company page (requires admin access).

name: attachments
label: Attachments
help: Media attachments for the post (max 9 images, or 1 video, or 1 document). Cannot mix different attachment types.

spec.name: url
spec.label: File URL
spec.help: Publicly accessible URL of the media file

spec.name: name
spec.label: Document Name
spec.help: Display name for the document (required for documents)
